name: Work Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Requires an employment agreement and proof of at least 3 years' relevant experience in the same field, translated and certified by the applicant's home-country foreign ministry and the Egyptian consulate.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a qualifying job offer and certify prior experience documentation.

requirements.blocker_text: Employers must maintain a 10:1 Egyptian-to-foreign worker ratio (foreign workers capped at roughly 10% of the workforce at any facility) -- exemptions exist for investors, staff under international agreements, and rare specialists.

evidence_required.document: Certified proof of 3+ years' relevant experience

outcome.duration_length: 1 year, renewable; must register with the Ministry of Manpower within 60 days of entry

sources.title: Mondaq -- Hire Foreign Workers in Egypt: Work Permit Guide, citing Egypt's Labour Law No. 12/2003 and Ministry of Manpower regulations: 10:1 Egyptianization ratio, 1-year permits, 60-day registration window, 3-year experience requirement
